title: The Mathematical Gazette
text:
The Mathematical Gazette is a triannual peer-reviewed academic journal published by Taylor & Francis on behalf of the Association for Mathematics in Education. It covers mathematics education with a focus on upper secondary school through to early-stage university study.
The journal was established in 1894 by Edward Mann Langley as the successor to the Reports of the Association for the Improvement of Geometrical Teaching. William John Greenstreet was its editor-in-chief for more than thirty years (1897–1930). Since July 2025, the editor is Peter Rowlett.

'''''The Mathematical Gazette''''' is a triannual [[peer-reviewed]] [[academic journal]] published by [[Taylor & Francis]] on behalf of the [[Association for Mathematics in Education]]. It covers [[mathematics education]] with a focus on upper secondary school through to early-stage university study.<ref name="gazette">{{cite web |title=About this journal |url=https://www.tandfonline.com/journals/tmgz20/about-this-journal |publisher=Association for Mathematics in Education |access-date=17 February 2026}}</ref>

The journal was established in 1894 by [[Edward Mann Langley]]<ref name="jdate">{{cite web |title=A complete index of articles and notes etc. from 1894 to 2007 |url=http://www.wpr3.co.uk/gazette/ |publisher=Association for Mathematics in Education |access-date=5 January 2012}}</ref> as the successor to the ''Reports of the Association for the Improvement of Geometrical Teaching''.<ref>{{cite book |title=Mathematics in Victorian Britain |editor1-first=Raymond |editor1-last=Flood |editor-link=Raymond Flood (mathematician) |editor2-first=Adrian |editor2-last=Rice |editor3-first=Robin |editor3-last=Wilson |editor3-link=Robin Wilson (mathematician) |publisher=[[Oxford University Press]] |year=2011 |isbn=978-0-19-162794-1 |page=171}}</ref> [[William John Greenstreet]] was its [[editor-in-chief]] for more than thirty years (1897–1930).<ref>{{cite journal |author1=I.F.S. Macaulay |author2=E.H. Neville |author3=C. Pendlebury |author4=J.A. Spender |author5=W.C.F. Anderson |year=1930 |title=Obituary: W.J. Greenstreet |journal=The Mathematical Gazette |volume=15 |issue=209 |pages=181–186 |jstor=3605787 |doi=10.1017/S0025557200137258 |s2cid=185174470}}</ref> Since July 2025, the editor is Peter Rowlett.

==Editors-in-chief==
The following persons are or have been editor-in-chief:<ref>{{cite journal |author=Amelia Curran |year=2026 |title=A brief history of "The Mathematical Gazette": thirty years later |journal=The Mathematical Gazette |doi=10.1080/00255572.2026.2619744 |doi-access=free}}</ref>
{{columns-list|

*[[Francis Sowerby Macaulay]]: 1896–1898
*[[William John Greenstreet]]: 1899–1930
*Alan Broadbent: 1931–1955
*[[Reuben Goodstein]]: 1956–1962

*Victor Bryant: 1980–1990

==Abstracting and indexing==
The journal is abstracted and indexed in [[EBSCO Information Services|EBSCO databases]],<ref name=MIAR>{{cite MIAR |title=The Mathematical Gazette |issn=0025-5572 |access-date=4 June 2023}}</ref> [[Emerging Sources Citation Index]],<ref name=ISI>{{cite web |url=http://mjl.clarivate.com/ |title=Web of Science Master Journal List |publisher=[[Clarivate]] |work=Intellectual Property & Science |access-date=3 June 2023}}</ref> [[Scopus]],<ref name=Scopus>{{cite web |url=https://www.scopus.com/sourceid/21100933892 |title=Source details: The Mathematical Gazette |publisher=[[Elsevier]] |work=Scopus Preview |access-date=3 June 2023}}</ref> and [[zbMATH Open]].<ref name=MATH>{{cite web |url=https://zbmath.org/serials/152 |title=The Mathematical Gazette |publisher=[[Springer Science+Business Media]] |work=[[ZbMATH Open]] |access-date=4 June 2023}}</ref>
